I would really think twice about using this place! I’m saddened that this has happened to me, and I’m saddened that I kept going back here, but not anymore.

So when I did a google search of dentists in Pattaya, I really didn’t know who to go with as there was too many to choose from, and the reviews were mixed. So, after looking at the pictures of this place online and reading the reviews, I decided to go with this place – also 1 factor in making this decision was the fact that it was in a shopping mall, and I assumed because it was in one, they would be very good as they would have to keep their reputation/service to a higher standard, but I was wrong.

Whilst the place is very nice and clean, it is very very small and really really basic. I soon found out that this place does not have everything here that other dentists in Pattaya have, like x-rays or CT scanners for instance.

I had nearly all my silver fillings removed and replaced with white fillings. I have issues with all of them because they did not clean the teeth properly when removing the silver fillings and so when the white filling were applied, you can still see the residue markings from the silver on them around the white fillings! Also, all my fillings were too sharp and not smoothed out properly. I know it’s not easy to get this right first time, and also because I don’t live there, I cannot go back easily to fix it, and so I have had to use a nail file to try to smooth the teeth myself, but this has and will cause issues for my teeth later on (I will be getting a few crowns so it will not be a problem later on). Also, when I asked them to smooth 1 tooth, they basically cut it flat and it looks now awful, hence why I decided to use a nail file myself instead of them cutting my teeth flat (I will have to replace that tooth with a crown now).

When I had my teeth whitened here, I didn’t have any printed instructions on what to do afterwards and for how long to look after them, unlike with what I received from another dentist I found in Pattya who were much better at this (they provided me a full information sheet). Also the results there were much better (maybe because that was my 2nd whitening session and the results after this first one, were more effective in that one).

I really do not feel confident in this place to do my teeth any further, and so I managed to find a much better place elsewhere in Pattaya who knock the socks off this place. They have everything you could think off, and are so advanced with the technology there and the service and results you get, you really don’t need to go anywhere else. Yes they are 50% more expensive than this place, but it’s well worth it. So basically, you get, what you pay for!

So just a warning, this place is ok and can help you out and maybe you will be all fine, but if you want a proper job without issues/complications, go elsewhere.
